author: Jessika Schmitz
title: Looking for artist to commission up to $600 USD
content: Looking for an artist to commission! I have a budget of up to 600 USD and I’m excited to discover artists with unique styles and creative ideas! If you’re currently open for commissions, drop your portfolio, art examples, and commission prices in the replies. #CommissionsArt Contact: reply with portfolio or DM

author: Asarc
title: Seeking artist for Christmas illustration of 2 girls with pair coord
content: #イラスト依頼 #有償依頼 12月半ばまでに女の子×2のコテ同イラスト描いていただける方探しております。 内容の詳細▶︎クリスマス用イラスト ペアコーデの衣装デザインもお願いしたいです。 予算▶︎~30000 Contact: reply or DM
